subject: Saving the first day of wear

messages.author: 33a987d6141d8d65
messages.subject: Saving the first day of wear
parts:
Hi Vincent and Colleagues,


Happy New Year!


I am new to GGIR but have now test-run several iterations of the code based on helpful guidance enclosed in this google group discussions. Thanks to everyone for their input!


Vincent, in your previous response to the topic “Valid days differ between part 2 output and part 5 output”, you mentioned that it may be possible to save more days of wear from the output in the new release of GGIR (my version: 1.11-0). 


I would like to save the first day of wear for the analyses in part 5. 


My subjects begin accelerometer wear at 7 am on Day 1. Many have more than 17 hours of wear during that first day. However, this day is always excluded from the analyses in part 5. I am using the following settings:


includedaycrit = 16

includenightcrit = 16

hrs.del.start = 0

hrs.del.end = 0

maxdur = 7

ignorenonwear=TRUE

constrain2range = TRUE


(please also find attached the full code)

 

Would it be possible to save that day for the analyses in part 5 and if so, would you be happy to advise on a specific setting which could help achieve it? 

 

Relatedly, if you were able to clarify what threshold range in the description of constrain2range provided in the manual refers to, I would appreciate it as I could not immediately map this description onto the steps described to in the Nature paper on HDCZA algorithm to define Sleep Period Time window. 


Description from the manual: “whether or not to constrain the range of the threshold used in the diary free Sleep period time window detection”?


Thank you in advance for your help.

Best wishes, 


Dominika
